people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jabesh
people.line: A town in Gilead, loyal to Saul

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

translations.web: They said, “What one is there of the tribes of Israel who didn’t come up to Yahweh to Mizpah?” Behold, no one came from Jabesh Gilead to the camp to the assembly.
translations.bsb: So they asked, “Which one of the tribes of Israel failed to come up before the LORD at Mizpah?” And, in fact, no one from Jabesh-gilead had come to the camp for the assembly.
translations.kjv: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up to Mizpeh to the LORD? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabeshgilead to the assembly.
translations.asv: And they said, What one is there of the tribes of Israel that came not up unto Jehovah to Mizpah? And, behold, there came none to the camp from Jabesh-gilead to the assembly.
